title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 81
description: Ten questions on Psalms 81: a call to sing at the feast, God's rescue from the burden, and his longing for a people who would listen.

questions.text: According to verse 1, what does the psalmist call God when he says "Sing aloud to God"?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says: "Sing aloud to God, our strength!"

questions.text: Which instrument is to be brought along with the pleasant lyre and the harp?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says to raise a song and bring the tambourine, the pleasant lyre with the harp.

questions.text: When is the trumpet to be blown?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says to blow the trumpet at the New Moon, at the full moon, on our feast day.

answers.text: At the New Moon, at the full moon, on our feast day
At the time of the evening sacrifice
At the start of the wheat harvest

questions.text: Verse 4 calls this a statute for Israel and an ordinance of whom?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says it is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.

questions.text: In whom was it appointed for a covenant, according to verse 5?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says he appointed it in Joseph for a covenant, when he went out over the land of Egypt.

questions.text: From what does God say "his hands were freed"?
questions.explanation: In verse 6 God says he removed his shoulder from the burden and his hands were freed from the basket.

questions.text: At which waters does God say, "I tested you"?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says: "I tested you at the waters of Meribah."

answers.text: The waters of the Red Sea

questions.text: What does Yahweh tell his people to do, promising "I will fill it"?
questions.explanation: In verse 10 Yahweh says: "Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it."

questions.text: After his people did not listen, what did God let them go after?
questions.explanation: Verses 11-12 say his people did not listen, so he let them go after the stubbornness of their hearts.

questions.text: What would God satisfy them with out of the rock?
questions.explanation: Verse 16 says: "I will satisfy you with honey out of the rock."
